name: Advent
description: A fun Christmas countdown with a full celebration on Dec 25. Nothing to configure, just add and enable.
author: Adam Selby

announce.title: Take Over the Board
announce.description: Interrupt your normal pages to show the countdown or Christmas celebration, then hand the board back.

announce_mode.title: Takeover Style
announce_mode.description: Four times a day, once a day, or the first few minutes of every hour. On Dec 25, the board is taken over all day regardless of this setting.

announce_hour.title: Start Hour
announce_hour.description: 0-23, local time. Once a day: when it starts. Every hour: the first hour it runs. Not used in four-times-a-day mode.

announce_end_hour.title: End Hour (every-hour style)
announce_end_hour.description: 0-24. The takeover doesn't start in this hour or later.

announce_minutes.title: Takeover Length (minutes)
announce_minutes.description: Once a day: up to 1440. Every hour: capped at 60.

takeover_priority.title: Takeover Priority
takeover_priority.description: When two takeovers overlap, the higher number wins. Defaults to 50, which beats the Holidays plugin (40) on Dec 24–25.

refresh_seconds.title: Refresh Interval (seconds)
refresh_seconds.description: How often to recompute (and reshuffle Christmas confetti). The date rolls over within this long of midnight.

is_active.description: "true" Dec 1–25, "false" the rest of the year

days.description: Days until Christmas (0 on Dec 25, empty outside Dec 1–25)

message.description: Empty Dec 1–23 (grid display). IT'S CHRISTMAS EVE on Dec 24. MERRY CHRISTMAS! on Dec 25.

confetti.description: 22 red/green/white tiles, reshuffled every refresh. Use LEFT(advent.confetti, n * 4) for fewer tiles.
